advanced-filter-description: Advanced susuña allows ukaru write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space awa used as a separator between the Operators. You can susuña for taqi Custom Fields by typing their names ukat values. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: If fields jan ukax values contains spaces, you need ukaru encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. For single control characters (' \/) ukaru be skipped, you can use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also you can combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally taqi operators apxi interpreted ukata left ukaru right. You can mayjtʼayaña the order by placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also you can thaqaña qillqa fields using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-recovery-busy: Apayañasa jan ukax siqina yaqha lurañasa saraskiwa. Machaqacham ukat mä juk'a pacha qhipat mayamp yant'am.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Aka katuqiritaki jichha siqinkir taqpach yatiyäwinak jaytañ munta? Utjirinakapax chhaqtayatäniwa ukat janiw kutt'ayasiñjamäkaniti. Aka mayiwi qhipat lurat machaq yatiyäwinakaxa imatäniwa.
email-recovery-description: Sapa katuqiritakixa mä siqi. Apnaqirin ID ukamp thaqam. Yatiyäwinakan utjirinakapa ukhamarak katuqirin elektroniku yatiyäwi chiqanakapaxa janiw uñacht'ayatäkiti. Mä juk'a sayt'ayañaxa jichha utjir ukhamarak jutïr yatiyäwinak suyt'ayi; sarantayañaxa siqinkir yatiyäwinak jichhax mayamp apayañ yant'i. Jaytañaxa mayiwi urasapkama siqiru uchata yatiyäwinak chhaqtayi. Apayañax saraskchi ukhaxa, mä juk'a pacha qhipat mayamp yant'am. Apayañ qalltat yatiyäwixa janiw kutt'ayaskaspati, ukat puritapax jan yatiskchi uka yatiyäwixa mayamp apayataspawa. Wiñay pantjasïwinaka ukhamarak yant'añ jakhuw jan mayamp jilxatañapatak utt'ayata tukuyir purir yatiyäwinakaxa uñakipañatak imatawa. Jan phuqhasir yatiyäwinak mayamp yant'añaxa machaq yant'äwinak qallti ukat utjki uka mä juk'a sayt'ayäwi imaraki.
email-recovery-empty: Janiw siqinkir yatiyäwinakas utjkiti, janirakiw apayañ mä juk'a sayt'ayata katuqirinakas utjkiti.
email-recovery-failed: Luräwi janiw chiqpachapunïtap uñacht'ayasiñjamäkänti. Siqi machaqacham ukat wakischi ukhaxa uka pachpa luräwi mayamp yant'am.
email-recovery-superseded: Luririn machaq luräwipaxa aka mayiwi lantiwa. Siqin jichha kunjamätap uñacht'ayaskiwa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Elektroniku yatiyäwi siqi janiw ullañjamäkiti. Irpirin mantañ kamachinakap ukhamarak servidor apnaqañjamätap uñakipam.

import-board-instruction-asana: Paste an Asana tasks anqäxar apayaña JSON ({ "data": [...] } ukata the Asana anqäxar apayaña jan ukax GET /tasks). Tasks apxi grouped into sections (memberships); tukuyata tasks go ukaru Done.
import-board-instruction-csv: Paste mana your Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck pirqa JSON (a pirqa mpi "stacks", each stack carrying its "cards"). Stacks become listanaka ukat tarjetanaka become tarjetanaka.
import-board-instruction-excel: ajlliña a WeKan-style .xlsx spreadsheet (the same columns as the Excel anqäxar apayaña: pʼiqiñcha, qhanañchäwi, kunjamasa/lista, miembros, Labels, dates, custom fields). The first row awa the header.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become tarjetanaka grouped into jistʼaraña / Closed listanaka.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Paste a Kanboard anqäxar apayaña JSON: an object mpi "columns" (jan ukax tasks carrying column_name) ukat a "tasks" array (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns become listanaka ukat tasks become tarjetanaka.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri ukan, Import & Export jist'araña ukat Export individual board (jan ukax Export all data) ajlliña, ukat .json qillqat qillqaqaña. Columnanakax listanakaruw tuku, tarjetanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku qhanañchäwipamp, tukuyañ urupamp, chimpunakapamp samipamp chika; mä tarjetan lurawinakapax mä uñakipañ listaruw tuku. Taqi datos mistuyäwitxa nayrïr pirqaw apanitaski.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Markdown lurawi qillqata apantaña (Obsidian Kanban jina markdown-kanban lurañanaka apnaqaña): "## List sutipa" uñstayirinaka, "- [ ]"/"- [x]" jaqukiwinakampi manqhankiri. Uñstayirinaka listanakawa tukuyi, jaqukiwinakasti tarjetanakawa tukuyi; checkbox janiwa listasa tarjeta jistarata jani apayasa mantayasa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard ukan, pirqa jist'araña, menú ukan Export this board... ukar ajlliña, .nbx qillqat mä qillqa askichirin jist'araña ukat ukan utjki uk qillqaqaña. Listanakax listanakaruw tuku, notas ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku: mä nota nayrïr siqix tarjeta sutipawa, mayninakapax qhanañchäwipawa. Mä raw notax raw chimpu katuqi. Walja pirqanïr qillqatax nayrïr pirqapakiw apanitaski.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Paste an OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become listanaka ukat work packages become tarjetanaka.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export ukana mistutapa lip'katayaña: JSON siqi, jan ukaxa sapa siqina mä lurawi. Tukuyata lurawinakaxa Done ukaru sarapxi, project ukampi priority ukampixa unanchanakaru tukupxi, annotations ukaxa arxatanakaru tuku, depends ukaxa jark'iri lurawinakampi chint'atäñaru tuku.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Mä todo.txt imata lip'iyam: sapa siqina mä luraña, todo.txt wakichäwi ukhamarak ukampi chikachasiñ atiri wakichäwinakax qillqapki ukhama. Tukuyata lurañanakax ("x") Tukuyata ukar sarapxi, +project ukat @context ukanakax chimpunakaruw tukupxi, (A) ukax nayrankañ chimpuw tuku, due: ukat t: ukanakax tukuyañ uru ukat qalltañ ururuw tukupxi.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Paste a ZenKit lista anqäxar apayaña JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become listanaka ukat items become tarjetanaka.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Mä Wrike lurañ thakhix estados ukanakan mä listapawa, sapa mayax Active, Completed, Deferred jan ukax Cancelled tamana. Mistuyañax aka pirqan listanakap mä ukham qillqi, pirqa sutipampi, Wrike API ukax lurañ thakhinakatak kutt'ayki uka JSON ukana: pirqan Wrike Excel mistuyäwip apaniñat nayraqat uka lurañ thakhi Wrike ukan lurt'aña, ukhamat estados ukanakapax apnaqatäñapataki. Apaniñax patan qillqaqata uka JSON liyi, WeKan ukat jan ukax Wrike GET /workflows ukat, ajllita pirqaru: jan listani estadox mä listaruw tuku, ukat mä kamachix mä tarjeta tukuyatjam chimpuchi Completed jan ukax Cancelled estado ukar unxtayatäki ukhax, ukat jan tukuyatjam Active jan ukax Deferred ukana. Wrike pachpa automatización kamachinakapax janiw Wrike ukat mistuyaskaspati.
